sources.entry: zstandard - Python bindings to the Zstandard (zstd) compression library.

summary.one_liner: Python bindings for the Zstandard (zstd) compression library, offering both a C extension and a CFFI interface.
use_cases: using zstd from a CFFI-based project
notable: Provides both a C extension and a CFFI interface
Aims to expose most of the Zstandard C API through a Pythonic interface
Canonical home and usage docs are hosted externally (linked in README)
Listed in awesome-python under File Manipulation
caveats: README is brief and defers usage details to external documentation
Installation and build steps are not given in the README
